slices.title: Patch existing code to resolve design review falsification findings
slices.jtbd: When implementing the falsification remediation for this epic, I want to patch the existing frontend code to resolve the 8 design review concerns, so that the number of unresolved falsification findings across the project decreases from 8 to 0.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given 8 unresolved falsification findings related to design review concerns,
When the existing code is patched directly without introducing new data schemas or API contracts,
Then the design review concerns are resolved and the unresolved findings count drops to 0.
Given the patched codebase,
When the UI components are tested and verified,
Then all tests pass and the visual regressions are fixed.
